name: starter-pack-record
title: Starter pack request and delivery record
for_each: select id, ref from samples where status = 'delivered' order by ref

sections.title: Request
sections.note: A written request before supply, with the name and address of the person supplied and the name, strength and quantity of the starter packs (Medicines Australia Code Ed. 20 s 6.1.5). Keep this record at least two years (s 6.1.6).
sections.sql: select ref, hcp as professional, profession, request_address as name_and_address, product_name as product, quantity, requested_on, request_kind as request from v_samples where id = $1

sections.title: Delivery
sections.note: New Zealand: the rep records the issue and gets the prescriber's signature (Medicines NZ Code Ed. 17 s 4.18.6), and the lot is kept so a recall reaches it (s 4.18.7).
sections.sql: select delivered_on, rep, sample_licence as rep_licence, lot_number, lot_expires as lot_expiry, receipt_signed_on as receipt_signed, recalled_on as lot_recalled, recall_told_on from v_samples where id = $1

name: rep-stock-statement
title: Sample stock statement
for_each: select id, code from reps where status = 'active' order by code

sections.title: Stock on hand
sections.sql: select product_name as product, lot_number, expires_on, on_hand, standing from v_rep_stock where rep_id = $1 order by product, expires_on

sections.title: Movements, last 90 days
sections.sql: select m.ref, m.moved_on, m.kind, p.code as product, l.lot_number, m.qty, coalesce(s.ref, '') as sample, coalesce(m.note, '') as note from stock_moves m join lots l on l.id = m.lot_id join products p on p.id = l.product_id left join samples s on s.id = m.sample_id where m.rep_id = $1 and m.moved_on >= current_date - 90 order by m.moved_on, m.ref

name: event-record
title: Event record
for_each: select id, ref from events where status <> 'cancelled' order by ref

sections.title: Event
sections.note: Hospitality secondary to the education, moderate and inside the cap (Medicines Australia Code Ed. 20 ss 4.5.2 and 4.5.3; Medicines NZ Code Ed. 17 s 4.8.2).
sections.sql: select ref, title, kind, country, held_on, venue, education, hours, meal_cents as food_and_drink_per_head_cents, case when country = 'NZ' then 'NZD' else 'AUD' end as currency, status from events where id = $1

sections.title: Attendees
sections.sql: select h.name, h.profession, a.role, case when a.attended then 'yes' when a.attended is false then 'no' else 'not recorded' end as attended from attendees a join hcps h on h.id = a.hcp_id where a.event_id = $1 order by a.role, h.name

sections.title: Payments to professionals
sections.sql: select x.ref, h.name, x.kind, x.amount_cents, x.currency, x.paid_on, x.notice_given_on as notice from transfers x join hcps h on h.id = x.hcp_id where x.event_id = $1 order by x.ref
